result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): I counted every template with the merge fields as written, and all eight texts are under 160 characters. A's run 143, 143, 146 and 137, and B's labeled counts of 140, 135, 130 and 135 are exact. Both answers keep the facts accurate, name the practice, give the C/R reply options and state the fee plainly. A wins narrowly because its #2 takes a different approach, framing the text as saving the patient's spot and pointing to the phone number with no fee. B's four texts carry labels like 'Friendly' and 'Fee-forward', but they share almost the same structure and fee line. B gives more useful notes on length and headroom. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): I counted every template and all eight are 160 characters or fewer: A's are 140/135/130/135, matching its own labels, and B's are 143/143/146/137. B's texts have less room (for example, #3 comes to about 151 once filled in) and B gives no per-message counts. Both answers get the facts right and keep the tone neutral.
